messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
['You have received 1 new message waiting in your inbox folder.', 'We recently have determined that different computers have logged onto your Internet Banking account, and multiple failure security number were present before the logons.', 'We are unable to process this payment to your account as your details has not been updated', 'This e-mail is to congratulate you as your email address have won you a cash prize of 715,000.00 in our Online Lottery Sweepstakes Promotion held in London NOV 2011.', 'As a result of unusual number of invalid login attempts on your account, we have reason to believe there might be security breach on your account.', 'Some Standard Bank customers have reported experiencing disconnect or write error issues with online banking.', 'You have 4 unread message(s)...', 'OFT announcement and decision of the Supreme Court (formerly House of Lords)', 'Here is your Lloyds TSB account summary for 15/10/2010.', 'But we face a problem in the verification of the real owner of the account.', 'You have a new secured message.', 'We would like to notify you that NatWest bank carries out customer data verification procedure that is compulsory for all NatWest bank customers.', 'For security reasons, you must update your account to restore full access to your Online Banking.', 'This is the last notice to inform you as of 12 - Sep - 2016 that you have not yet updated your iCloud ID information.', 'However a full upgrade of your account was not successful due to various technical issues.', 'To better protect you against fraud, we have temporarily suspended your online service.', 'NatWest has noticed an indefinite Logon on your account from a blacklisted Internet Protocol (I. P), therefore you are advice to follow the instructions below to safeguard your account and also protect it from being suspended', 'An error was detected on your online banking details.', 'But we have held it for the moment because the amount is over the security borders of our rules.', 'We detected irregular activity on your HSBC Internet banking account on 27/05/2010.', 'You sent a payment for $655.83 USD to Brant Everett.', 'Your account has open issues : Click to Resolve', 'Your company or your personal E-mail address, attached to winning number 23-76-06-54-42-100, with Serial number 647489, consequently won in the Tenth lottery category.', 'We recently reviewed your account and suspect...', 'We have reasons to believe that a 3rd-party IP tried to access your online banking account.', 'This message confirms your NatWest Secure password has changed on Tue, Nov 5, 2013 17:09:45(GMT).']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
